function.name: LSP
function.description: Resolve a symbol using the language server. Accepts one-based input positions. Returns raw LSP results with file URIs and zero-based UTF-16 ranges. Edit files with Write so the language server sees changes.

filePath.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the agent's current working directory.

character.description: 1-based character offset in UTF-16 code units (same as character count for ASCII).
